name: Testing Library
one_liner: Query components the way users find them, not by implementation detail.
what_it_is: A family of libraries for querying rendered components by accessible role, label and visible text rather than by class names or component internals, with bindings for React, Vue, Svelte and others.
why_it_matters: Its lasting contribution is a principle rather than an API: tests coupled to implementation break on every refactor and therefore get deleted. Querying by accessible role has the useful side effect of surfacing accessibility problems, because a component you cannot query by role is usually one a screen reader cannot navigate either.
suitable_for: Component tests intended to survive refactoring
Teams wanting tests that incidentally check accessibility
Any of the frameworks it provides bindings for
not_suitable_for: Testing genuinely internal logic, which belongs in plain unit tests
Full user-journey coverage, which needs an E2E tool
